inferences.claim: Moriarty should separate signature adapter, bounded intent, candidate proposal, objective correctness proof and ledger submission; no inspected signature mechanism establishes the required general correctness relation.
A versioned semantic envelope and explicit failure obligations are needed for Moriarty; copying DefusePayload unchanged would omit required bindings.

Moriarty must support typed staged continuations, partial/contingent settlement, per-stage authority and failure accounting, authenticated joins, refund/compensation and persistent residual duties; no simulated global rollback.
